name: constructor

name: getState

doc: Returns the settled value (fulfilled or fault value); throws while pending. A pure peek: reading a fault does not acknowledge it (see markHandled)

name: markHandled

name: reject
doc: Faults a pending Future with value (default null); ignored if already settled

name: resolve
doc: Settles a pending Future with value (default null); ignored if already settled
